objective: Decide which manuscript claims the existing certificates strengthen and whether further symbolic proof has incremental value
method: Read preserved manuscript, proof documents, source text, frozen results and receipts; classify claims and source availability; verify identities and document references only
source_policy: Use exact obtained theorem statements only; identify historical secondary inspection claims separately from currently available primary text; do not infer novelty from access failures or failed direct substitutions
output: New English claim-to-evidence document, theorem/source matrix, symbolic-proof value decision, source/file hashes and an identity-only checker
forbidden: No scientific reruns, GPU, CUDA, kernel, compiler/install, paid work, Library or B2 transfer, new publication destination, external human messages, source overwrite or permission/certificate bypass
